collection: Static Section content, not a Collection
note: Real: confirmed platforms from the live site's header social icons — TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Discord, X, Twitch, Facebook. Rendered as a simple pill-link row with a CSS-only color-sweep hover (css/interactions.css .social-link, js/content-loader.js's socialLinkHtml()) — no card imagery, no JS beyond the render loop. Maps directly to a native Social Links Block; the hover sweep can be recreated with Custom CSS on that block or simply dropped.
